_about: Product problems for Lesson 21. Each criterion needs a score from 1 to 5 and a non-empty evidence note. Maintenance is scored as lightness of tail: 5 means light, 1 means heavy.

problems.name: No-show reminders and rebooking for clinics

evidence.pain_severity: Clinic owners name empty slots as lost revenue in discovery calls
evidence.frequency: Appointments run daily in every clinic
evidence.ability_to_pay: Clinics already pay for booking software
evidence.distribution_reach: Reachable through the med spa and clinic audience built in Module 5
evidence.maintenance_lightness: Reminder rules change rarely, integrations are stable

problems.name: Invoice chasing helper for a solo practice

evidence.pain_severity: Late payment is a recurring complaint in solo practice forums
evidence.frequency: Invoices are issued weekly in a typical practice
evidence.ability_to_pay: Solo practices pay for accounting tools but budgets are thin
evidence.distribution_reach: No existing audience, reach depends on partner accountants
evidence.maintenance_lightness: Templates and schedules are stable once set

problems.name: Fully autonomous tax filing for freelancers

evidence.pain_severity: Tax deadlines cause acute stress each year
evidence.frequency: Filing is annual for most freelancers, so use is rare
evidence.ability_to_pay: Freelancers pay accountants significant annual fees
evidence.distribution_reach: No trusted channel into this audience yet
evidence.maintenance_lightness: Tax rules change every year in every jurisdiction, so the tail is heavy and risky
